# Prostate Cancer Active-Surveillance Counselling Calculators

> Open-access research hub for externally-validated prostate cancer
> prediction-model calculators that support active-surveillance entry
> counselling. Calculators implement the frozen Polish-derived
> logistic-regression models from the Jobczyk et al. 2026 manuscript
> (submitted to *Prostate Cancer and Prostatic Diseases*).

This is a research-grade open-access decision aid. It is not a CE-marked or
FDA-approved medical device and does not replace clinical judgement.

## Calculator (MS3 ISUP Upgrade Risk)

URL: https://kstawiski.github.io/prostate-rarp-calculators/ms3/

The MS3 calculator estimates the probability of any-grade International
Society of Urological Pathology (ISUP) upgrade from pre-operative biopsy to
radical-prostatectomy pathology. A secondary research-only endpoint
estimates the probability of a major upgrade from biopsy ISUP 1-2 to
prostatectomy ISUP ≥ 3.

### Inputs

- Biopsy ISUP grade group (1, 2, 3, or 4 — grade 5 cannot upgrade)
- Pre-operative PSA (ng/mL, log-transformed as log(PSA + 1) internally)
- Optional (full 7-predictor mode):
  - Age (years)
  - Positive cores / total cores (positive-core ratio)
  - MRI-fusion biopsy yes / no
  - Clinical T stage (T1 / T2 / T3+)
  - PI-RADS category (1-2 / 3 / 4 / 5)

### Modes

- **Parsimonious (default, recommended for AS counselling)** — uses only
  biopsy ISUP grade and log(PSA + 1).
- **Full 7-predictor** — adds age, positive-core ratio, MRI-fusion status,
  clinical T stage, and PI-RADS category.

### Key performance numbers

- Polish derivation cohort: n = 820 (any-upgrade analytic), single-surgeon
  prostatectomies, 2017-2024. Apparent AUC 0.810, optimism-corrected AUC
  0.798.
- US Brigham and Women's Hospital validation cohort: n = 562 (any-upgrade),
  multi-surgeon prostatectomies, 2018-2024. Frozen-coefficient external
  AUC 0.722 (95% CI 0.661-0.774). Pre-specified 0.05 AUC preservation
  margin was *not* met (drop of 0.076).
- US AS-eligible biopsy ISUP 1-2 subset: n = 357. External AUC 0.771
  (95% CI 0.670-0.846).
- Parsimonious 2-predictor model matches the full 7-predictor model in
  external discrimination (paired ΔAUC +0.002, 95% CI -0.018 to +0.019).
- Removing MRI-fusion biopsy plus PI-RADS from the full 7-predictor model
  produces ΔAUC +0.00002 (likelihood-ratio p = 0.22).
- AS-eligible operating point (Polish-derived Youden cut-off 0.65 applied
  to US AS-eligible subset): positive predictive value 85.5% (95% CI
  71.2-93.4), specificity 96.6% (92.2-98.5), sensitivity 44.8%
  (35.0-55.0), negative predictive value 79.4% (73.4-84.3).

### Important caveats

- Both cohorts are surgery-conditioned (verification bias). True
  active-surveillance candidates typically have a lower base rate of
  upgrade (around 10-15%) than the 25-31% observed here.
- The AS-eligible-subset positive predictive value drops when projected to
  realistic AS-entry prevalences: approximately 70% at 15% prevalence,
  approximately 59% at 10% prevalence (Supplementary Table S29).
- The major-upgrade endpoint is research-only and uninformative on external
  validation (AUC 0.635, 95% CI 0.501-0.729; 62 events; lower CI bound
  near chance). It is not suitable for clinical deployment.
- In the full 7-predictor model, only log(PSA + 1) and biopsy ISUP have
  95% odds-ratio confidence intervals that exclude 1.0 after mutual
  adjustment. Age, positive-core ratio, MRI-fusion biopsy, clinical T
  stage, and all three PI-RADS levels each have CIs that include 1.0.
  This is why the parsimonious model matches the full model.
- PI-RADS coefficients are not strictly monotonic in the frozen full model
  (vs PI-RADS 1-2 reference: 3 = -0.575, 4 = -0.428, 5 = +0.040). This is
  a verification-bias signature in the RP-conditioned cohort, not a code
  bug; an MRI-targeted biopsy of a PI-RADS 5 lesion is more likely to have
  sampled the worst focus.

## Source manuscript

- **Title**: Biopsy-upgrading prediction model for active-surveillance
  entry counselling: a Polish-US external validation
- **Reporting guideline**: TRIPOD+AI 2024 (Collins et al., BMJ 2024)
- **Status**: Submitted to *Prostate Cancer and Prostatic Diseases*
  (Nature Portfolio / Springer Nature)
- **Authors**: Mateusz Jobczyk, Timothy N. Clinton, Piotr Ciechanowski,
  Mikołaj Frankiewicz, Rafał Bogdan Drobot, Wojciech Fendler,
  Filipe L. De Carvalho, Konrad Stawiski

## Code and data

- **Zenodo deposit (DOI)**: 10.5281/zenodo.20362700
- **Concept DOI (all versions)**: 10.5281/zenodo.20362699
- **GitHub source**: https://github.com/kstawiski/prostate-rarp-calculators
- **License**: MIT (code); CC-BY-4.0 (documentation)

The Zenodo deposit contains all R analysis scripts, frozen logistic-
regression coefficient JSON files, and reproducibility documentation. It
does not contain patient-level data (IRB-restricted; BWH protocol
2021P002957 + Polish RNN/99/26/KE).

## Suggested citation

> Jobczyk M, Clinton TN, Ciechanowski P, Frankiewicz M, Drobot RB,
> Fendler W, De Carvalho FL, Stawiski K. Biopsy-upgrading prediction model
> for active-surveillance entry counselling: a Polish-US external
> validation. Manuscript submitted to *Prostate Cancer and Prostatic
> Diseases* (Nature Portfolio), 2026. Online calculator and frozen
> coefficients: https://kstawiski.github.io/prostate-rarp-calculators/ms3/
> (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20362700).
